'''Salus-Mok''' was a [[Voss Mystics|Voss Mystic]] living on [[Voss]] during the [[Galactic War]]. They had a vision of [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] logging machines threatening the [[Voss (species)|Voss]], which could be destroyed only by outsiders.
